# Nikita Mukhortov — Product Design Portfolio

Canonical site: https://niplusm.github.io/nplusm/

Nikita Mukhortov is an Amsterdam-based product designer positioning for Staff Product Designer roles in AI and developer tools. His current employment title is Product Design Lead, AI & R&D at JetBrains. His work covers product strategy, user research, coded prototyping, design systems and cross-functional delivery, with earlier experience in fintech, Web3, marketplaces, consumer health and telecom.

## Primary pages

- Portfolio and selected work: https://niplusm.github.io/nplusm/

- Scientific publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01969
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nik-mukhortov-5199351ab/
